arguments.need: I've been running several AI coding agents on the same repo and it's getting chaotic: they step on each other's files and I lose track of why each change was made. I want something that runs on my own machine and queues up agent jobs, gives each one its own isolated copy of the repo, and only opens a pull request after I approve. It has to reuse the agent CLIs I'm already logged into rather than asking me for API keys, and it can't phone home or send usage data anywhere. Free and open source only, please.
